DIRECTIVE — Alex, 2026-08-25. TWO ANSWERS FOR CC, plus a correction on the store.

1) 65233 — A vs B. DO BOTH, A FIRST. Build A now (tokened public share-link, no SSO) so Alex can read a spec today. Then B (org-scoping, BEB-1884/630/952/1605) as the systemic chain — it is the real cause and does not get dropped once A unblocks reading. A is not the fix, it is the unblock.

2) SERVICE BINDINGS, YES — agreed and generalize it. Every doc-store viewer binds to bbdocs-mcp as a SERVICE BINDING, never a public Worker→Worker fetch. Your own read is right: the 1042, the graph write, the read-gate and the vault failures are ONE CLASS — same-account public fetches that should be bindings. Fix the class, not the four instances, and report how many call sites you changed.

3) 65235 — NO SUPABASE. Standing order 2026-08-07, still in force: no new work IN Supabase at all — no tables, no migrations, no lanes into it. [redacted] in bbdocs' Supabase is refused. THE STORE IS D1. Everything else in your decision is right and stands: doc ACLs co-locate with the docs, resource-level grants in bbdocs, Identity Worker stays the TOOL-level grant authority, no protected-worker edit, private-by-default viewer, no blanket bypass. Same table shape, D1 instead.

4) EDIT-PROTECTED WORKERS — do not route around them silently. abilifi-identity being on your deny-list is correct and stays. But when a protected worker blocks a build, say so as a named blocker rather than picking a second-best home for the data. In this case co-location is right on its own merits, so proceed — this is about the general habit.

5) BEB-2690 §3 IS STILL FIRING — 4× today now (65212, 65213, 65214, 65234), same text, unacted. The bridge dedup landed but the underlying red has not been touched. This is precisely the asst manager's DIFF case: a counter whose shape is identical on an empty pass and a healthy one. Either fix the emitter to report eligibility per pass, or say plainly why it cannot be fixed. It does not get
DIRECTIVE 65236 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1884, BEB-2690, BEB-1084, BEB-1510, BEB-1938, BEB-2854 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

DIRECTIVE — Alex, 2026-08-25. REPORTS OVER TIME — ASSEMBLE, DO NOT REBUILD.

Alex: "measure it well, let's see reports over time, do it smartly, we have log patterns already, look it up, don't rebuild what we have." Correct — I looked. Almost all of it is already specced and sitting in todo. Nothing new gets authored.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS (read these before writing a line):
- BEB-3516 METRICS DASH (P1, todo, ETA 08-17, OVERDUE) — already specs time-to-correct (median/mean/p90), attempts-to-correct, signed forecast deviation, breakdown by lane kind and defect class, and TREND over time so a fix shows as a bend in the line. That is the reports-over-time ticket. It exists, it is late, it is not built.
- BEB-3507 BLOCK LIBRARY — metric-tile, distribution, deviation-chart, ranked-table as reusable graph-node blocks. Every dashboard element comes from here. A bespoke panel is a fail (3516's own acceptance says so).
- BEB-3518 MOTION BLOCKS + BEB-2023 — fuse-style burndown, driven by the real number, with IDLE-IS-NOT-DEAD: a stalled loop shows the fire going out, visibly different from a broken page. That is the stale-series requirement already solved in the motion language.
- BEB-3908 APP ROADMAP GRAPH — the DERIVED score out of 10, never hand-set, and movement since last snapshot with the changed point named. That is combination reporting and score-goes-down already specced.
- BEB-2196 ACTIVITY LOG + CHANGELOG — the per-project record over time.
- BEB-2347 THE RECORD — the source. Measures come from it, never estimated.
- BEB-3517 — every ticket number a link, Ask Orky on every page. Applies to every panel.
- STANDING DIG doc 878fd954 §8 already ruled the storage: ANALYTICS ENGINE for hot time-series (all trend charts), DO SQLite for live per-subject state, KV is the read-mostly mirror and NEVER the read-back store. Do not re-derive this. Series go to AE.

THE ONLY NEW RULE (Alex 2026-08-25): a monitoring tick ships its dashboard element IN THE SAME TICKET. Not a later U

DIRECTIVE — Alex, 2026-08-25. CC BUILDS 65238 NOW. The loop is stuck on containers doing makework.

Alex's read, and it is correct: the loop is spinning on container work that produces nothing while the reports Alex needs sit overdue. Do not wait for the loop to claim 3516. CC builds it directly under the infra unlock (65230).

BUILD 65238 AS SPECCED — assemble from what exists, author nothing new:
- BEB-3516 METRICS DASH (P1, ETA 08-17, OVERDUE) is the ticket. Its spec is complete: time-to-correct median/mean/p90, attempts-to-correct, signed forecast deviation, breakdown by lane kind and defect class, TREND over time. Read it and build it verbatim. Do not re-scope it, do not write a thinner version.
- Panels from BEB-3507 block library — metric-tile, distribution, deviation-chart, ranked-table, as registered graph-node blocks. A bespoke panel fails 3516's own acceptance.
- Series storage: ANALYTICS ENGINE, already ruled in doc 878fd954 §8. Not KV, not a new store. Do not re-derive this decision.
- Source of measures: BEB-2347, the record. Never estimated.
- Template rules hold: themeset colour only, AJAX, no reload, ticket numbers are links (BEB-3517), named EMPTY on zero rows.

FIRST PANEL, before the rest: QUEUED / CLAIMED / DONE on one chart over 24h. That is the exact combination that would have shown last night's failure — each series alone looked ordinary. Every series renders its own freshness; a stale feed must not look like a flat line.

NO CONTAINERS. This is a dash on existing blocks reading existing data. If a container, an image build or a sandbox appears in the path, it is the wrong path — say so instead of building it.

REPORT: which existing tickets you CLOSED, and the URL Alex opens. Not what you wrote.
